(印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 4543/8
Date 14/7 1933)

Special Branch,
July 13, 1933.

Superintendent Robertson
(S.1 and S.2):

Please report any information which comes to
your notice about the presence in hotels or elsewhere
in the Settlement of officials or agents of the
Public Safety Bureau or other organs of the Chinese
Authorities who appear to have come here to search
for persons who are wanted by the Chinese Authorities
in connection with Communist and other reactionary
activities, tax evasion, etc. etc. In his meetings
with representatives of the Chinese Authorities,
Supt. Tan should be always on the look out for
information of the character mentioned and should
report without delay any which comes to his notice.

T. P. Givens
Officer i/c Special Branch.

(批：SR)

特别股，
1933年7月13日。

罗伯逊巡官（S.1 和 S.2）：

请报告任何引起你们注意的、关于中国当局公安局或其他机关的官员或代理人出现在租界内旅馆或其他地方的信息，这些人似乎是为了搜寻被中国当局通缉的与共产主义及其他反动活动、逃税等等相关的人员而来。谭巡官在与中方代表会晤时，应时刻留意上述性质的信息，并在获悉后毫不迟延地予以报告。

T. P. 吉文斯
特别股主管警官。

（批：SR）

G. 35m-11-32

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. .........
S.I., S.B. Station,
REPORT
Date July 11, 19 33

Subject (in full) Investigation Bureaux of Chinese Authorities existing in
Settlement.

Made by ............ and .................... Forwarded by Superintendent Robertson

I cannot see that the Special Branch can supply
information daily on the presence in the Settlement of
such offices or bases, but it can inform Louza
confidentially as and when it is obtained. As I have
already stated in my report of June 27, Special Branch
information in this respect has hitherto been very
scanty indeed. It is worthy of note that at the
moment investigation into communist activities by the
Central Political Council is more or less at a standstill
as a result of the assassination of Ma Shao-wu, and the
Central Council appears to have realized its mistake in
enlisting wholesale as agents so-called converts from
Communism.

If Ma's successor, when he takes over his duties
here, can be made to have confidence in and cooperate
fully with the Municipal Police, it will go a long way
towards eliminating illegal functioning and surreptitious
workings of his agents in the Settlement.

（批：D.D.G A / Int. Smn (L)）
（印：RENT COMMISSIONER / JUL 11 1933 / (CHINA) BRANCH）
（批：Kindly action / to Actg Supt）
Theo Robertson
Superintendent.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
（批：d.b. (bruno)）

（左侧边缘批注：/ Gen Gds (L) / Please note / for action / to Officer / i/c B / Rgd）

（底部手写批注：Unless special reasons exist for acting differently, the S.P.B. will communicate to Louza any information obtained about the presence of agents of Chinese Authorities engaged in hunting communists.）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号 ____ 
S.I.，特别股分站，
报告
日期 1933年7月11日

主题（全称） 存在于租界内的中国当局调查机构。

由 ____ 和 ____ 制作，由罗伯逊巡官转发

我认为特别股无法每日提供关于此类办事处或据点存在于租界内的信息，但可以在获得信息时机密地通知老闸捕房。正如我在6月27日的报告中已经陈述的那样，特别股在此方面的信息迄今为止确实非常匮乏。值得注意的是，目前中央政治委员会对共产主义活动的调查因马绍武遇刺案而或多或少陷入停滞，且中央委员会似乎已意识到其大规模招募所谓“脱离共产主义者”作为代理人的错误。

如果马绍武的继任者在接任此地职务时，能够建立对工部局警务处的信任并与其充分合作，将极大地有助于消除其代理人在租界内的非法运作和秘密活动。

（批：D.D.G A / Int. Smn (L)）
（印：租金 commissioner / 1933年7月11日 / （中国）分处）
（批：请采取行动 / 致代巡官）
西奥·罗伯逊
巡官。

特别股主管警官。
（批：d.b. (bruno)）

（左侧边缘批注：/ Gen Gds (L) / 请注意 / 采取行动 / 致主管警官 / i/c B / Rgd）

（底部手写批注：除非有特殊理由采取不同行动，否则特别股将把获得的关于从事搜捕共产党人的中国当局代理人出现在租界内的任何信息通报给老闸捕房。）

Form No. 3
G. 25,000-I-32

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

File No............

S.I., S.B. Station,
Date June 27, 19 33

REPORT

Subject (in full) Investigation Bureaux of Chinese Authorities existing in
Settlement

Made by and Forwarded by Superintendent Robertson

While there can be no objection to the Chief Inspector-
in-Charge and Senior Detective, Louza, being kept posted
(confidentially) of any base, office or room known to the
Special Branch as being utilized by emissaries of the Chinese
Authorities as liaison centres or bases to facilitate
investigation, it must be noted that Special Branch knowledge
in this respect is very limited. In view of this, I doubt
very much if the acquisition of this scanty information would
assist Louza in the event of political murders. Assassination
has always been a popular mode of elimination of opponents in
Chinese political circles and indications do not point to a
change to something more civilized, but, on the contrary, there
is every reason to anticipate that once a certain clique
(blue shirt) finds itself on firmer ground than at present,
elimination of its political opponents will follow.
The only cure as far as I can see is to intensify
police visitation to hotels and lodging houses together with
interrogation of guests on lines more rigorous than hitherto.

（批：B. (Brine) I agree J.R. O. i/c Sp. Br. JUNE 30 1933）

Thos Robertson
Superintendent.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

G. 25,000-I-32

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

档案号 ____ 

S.I.，特别股分站，
日期 1933年6月27日

报告

主题（全称） 存在于租界内的中国当局调查机构

由罗伯逊巡官制作并转发

虽然对于让督察长兼高级侦探、老闸捕房的卢扎（Louza）随时（机密地）了解特别股所知的、被中国当局使者用作联络中心或据点以便利调查的任何基地、办公室或房间，并无异议，但必须指出，特别股在此方面的知识非常有限。鉴于此，我深表怀疑，在发生政治谋杀案时，获取这些 scanty（稀少）的信息是否有助于卢扎。暗杀在中国政界一直是清除对手的流行手段，迹象并未表明会转向更文明的方式，相反，我们有充分理由预期，一旦某个派系（蓝衣社）发现其地位比现在更稳固，随之而来的将是对其政治对手的清除。
就我所见，唯一的补救办法是加强对旅馆和寄宿房屋的警察巡查，并以比以往更严格的方式盘问住客。

（批：B. (Brine) 我同意 J.R. O. i/c Sp. Br. 1933年6月30日）

托马斯·罗伯逊
巡官。

特别股主管警官。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ________
S.2. Special Branch. ~~Station~~
REPORT
Date June 22, 1933.

Subject (in full)    Retribution.

Made by __ and    Forwarded by __ D.I. Ross.

With reference to the attached report dated June 20,
1933 on the subject of 'retribution' among political
adherents and loafer gangs, I have to state that I agree
in principle with the suggestion of preventative measures
to be adopted by the Municipal Police as laid forward by
C.D.I. Robertson.

However, there remains room to doubt the practica-
bility of the material suggestion contained therein as to
advise the Chinese authorities to refrain from resorting
to the use of hotels and lodging houses in the Settlement
because it can be safe enough to say that practically on
every occasion there will be no conclusive evidence
forthcoming to link their proposed object of renting the
room with anything illegal. On the other hand, however,
it is highly advisable to have more frequent and periodical
visits to hotels and lodging houses in the Settlement with
a view to combing out undesirables.

My suggestion therefore is that in the event of
members of the Public Safety Bureau deeming it necessary
to establish a temporary communication office in the
Settlement to facilitate investigation into cases they
do so with the sanction and cooperation of the Municipal
Police.

〔此处有手写签名〕
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
〔此处有手写签名及日期戳记：30 1933〕

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案号 ________
S.2. 特别股 ~~分站~~
报告
日期 1933年6月22日。

主题（全称）    报复。

由 __ 制作，并由 __ 警探长罗斯转发。

关于附上的1933年6月20日关于政治追随者和流氓帮派之间“报复”主题的报告，我必须声明，我原则上同意警探长罗伯逊提出的、由工部局警务处采取的预防性措施建议。

然而，对于其中包含的实质性建议——即建议中国当局避免使用租界内的旅馆和寄宿房屋——其可行性仍存疑，因为几乎可以肯定的是，实际上在每次情况下，都不会有确凿的证据将其租赁房间的预定目的与任何非法行为联系起来。另一方面，更加频繁和定期地访问租界内的旅馆和寄宿房屋以清查不受欢迎分子，是极为可取的。

因此，我的建议是，如果公安局成员认为有必要在租界内设立临时通讯处以便利案件调查，他们应在工部局警务处的批准和合作下进行此事。

〔此处有手写签名〕
警探长。

特别股主管警官。
〔此处有手写签名及日期戳记：30 1933〕

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ............
S.1, Special Branch STATION
REPORT
Date June 23, 1933.

Subject (in full) Report on attached.

Made by Supt. Tan Shao-liang Forwarded by Thos Robertson, Supt.

I do not agree with suggestion of C.D.I. Robertson.
If the search parties are carried out as suggested,
it would force the members of the Public Safety Bureau to
move to dwelling house for the same purpose and in the same
district. Besides it will cause ill feeling and retaliation
of the Public Safety Bureau whose members are likely to
obstruct our men when proceeding to Chinese territory to
make enquiries.

Tan Shaoliang
Superintendent.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

JUNE 30 1933

主题（全称） 关于附件的报告。

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, TUESDAY, JUNE 20, 1933

Political Gangdom
Rival murder gangs seem to be
developing activity within the
International Settlement and the
French Concession. Recent crimes
are believed to be the outcome of
political disagreements between
certain rival groups in Chinese
politics. The Settlement and the
Concession have traditionally given
asylum to refugees for whom
residence in China would not be
healthy. There is no reason why
this privilege should be abused. In
other words the Police authorities
would have full public support if
they took drastic action to prevent
this place from becoming a play-
ground for murderous controversial-
ists. The existence of these gangs
must be tolerably well-known to the
Police who, in view of the recent
crimes, would be perfectly justified
in rounding up the gangsters and
transferring them gently but firmly
to Chinese territory where, no
doubt, political assassination would
receive suitable corrective treat-
ment.
pages.zh:
《字林西报》，1933年6月20日，星期二

政治帮派
敌对的谋杀帮派似乎正在国际租界和法租界内发展活动。最近的犯罪被认为是中国政治中某些敌对团体之间政治分歧的结果。租界和公传统上为那些在中国居住并不安全的难民提供庇护。没有理由滥用这一特权。换句话说，如果警方采取严厉行动，防止这个地方成为谋杀性争议者的游乐场，他们将获得公众的全力支持。这些帮派的存在警方必然相当清楚，鉴于最近的犯罪，警方完全有理由围捕这些歹徒，并将他们温和但坚定地移交给中国领土，在那里，毫无疑问，政治暗杀将得到适当的矫正处理。
